el.Clases, cursos y mentorías de yoga para: Yoga classes, courses and mentorships to practice and learn at your own pace
el.Soy profesora de yoga y comparto clases,: I'm a yoga teacher, and I share classes, courses and mentorships. I like practice to be studied, tested in the body and carried into everyday life, at your own pace, live or recorded.
el.También acompaño a otras profes en el Gr: I also support other teachers in the Grupo de Estudio y Prácticas Docentes, a space where we think together, ask ourselves questions and keep learning side by side.
el.Pensar colectivamente: cuestionar lo apr: Thinking collectively: questioning what we've learned, asking ourselves new questions and continuing to build knowledge.
